article.story: No. 20 Northwestern (6-1) at Oregon (4-3), Oct. 31 at 3:30 p.m. EDT. Opening Line: Oregon by 3.5. Against the spread: Oregon 2-5, Northwestern 5-2. How to watch: Peacock Key stats Oregon Offense Overall: 423.1 yards per game (43rd in FBS) Passing: 278.0 yards per game (24th) Rushing: 145.1 yards per game (87th) Scoring: 33.1 points per game (40th) Oregon Defense Overall: 325.4 yards per game (39th in FBS) Passing: 197.6 yards per game (44th) Rushing: 127.9 yards per game (52nd) Scoring: 20.7 points per game (39th) Northwestern Offense Overall: 435.6 yards per game (33rd in FBS) Passing: 231.0 yards per game (67th) Rushing: 204.6 yards per game (24th) Scoring: 34.7 points per game (35th) Northwestern Defense Overall: 364.6 yards per game (74th in FBS) Passing: 211.9 yards per game (74th) Rushing: 152.7 yards per game (88th) Scoring: 16.6 points per game (22nd) Northwestern ranks 21st in FBS in third down percentage, converting 47.6% of the time. Oregon is 71st in the FBS with an even turnover margin, compared to Northwestern's 6th-ranked +9 margin. Oregon is 61st in FBS in red zone defense, allowing opponents to score on 82.6% of trips. Northwestern's red zone offense ranks 2nd, scoring on 96.9% of red zone opportunities. Oregon ranks 102nd in the FBS with an average time of possession of 28:54, compared to Northwestern's 41st-ranked average of 31:11. Team leaders Oregon Passing: Dante Moore, 926 yards, 9 TDs, 0 INTs, 69.7 completion percentage Rushing: Jordon Davison, 422 yards on 88 carries, 7 TDs Receiving: Dakorien Moore, 417 yards on 34 catches, 4 TDs Northwestern Passing: Aidan Chiles, 1,617 yards, 12 TDs, 1 INT, 71.3 completion percentage Rushing: Caleb Komolafe, 551 yards on 88 carries, 5 TDs Receiving: Griffin Wilde, 615 yards on 39 catches, 4 TDs Last game Oregon fell 21-10 to Illinois on Oct. 24. Dylan Raiola led Oregon with 246 yards on 27-of-41 passing (65.9%) for no touchdowns and no interceptions. Davison carried the ball 14 times for 92 yards and scored one touchdown, adding one reception for three yards. Dakorien Moore put up 70 yards on nine catches. Northwestern defeated Rutgers 42-14 on Oct. 24. Chiles threw for 219 yards on 19-of-25 attempts (76.0%) with three touchdowns and one interception. He also carried the ball 12 times for 83 yards and two rushing touchdowns. Komolafe carried the ball 13 times for 150 yards and scored one touchdown. Wilde had nine receptions for 133 yards and one touchdown. Next game Oregon plays at No. 2 Ohio State on Nov. 7. Northwestern hosts Iowa on Nov. 7.
